decisions.reason: The dimension change belongs to drawing annotation accuracy and does not alter the drawing-set package, formats, or delivery sequence; the separate format and sequence clauses from the same message are already represented.
The functional and overall dimension annotations do not alter 3D model delivery or its required file formats; the source message's separate 3D-format clause is already represented.
Showing the overall dimension optionally in brackets is specific to the dimension-annotation Requirement and does not change the candidate's template, numbering, color, or view-style conventions.
The reference to distance between holes concerns a drawing dimension and does not modify the bushing arrangement, guidance, retention, clearance, or retained-hole decisions.
The source resolves which linear drawing dimensions to show and does not change the welded-lug fabrication sequence, 45-degree hole-axis spacing, or face-finishing rules.
